observations.description: Buttnick-labeled photo shows a corridor with brick surfaces and supports; City Loan-labeled photo shows an overhead slab.
Images show brick ceiling surfaces, metal members, corrugated panels and visibly different patches.
Briefing reports brick-arch replacement with concrete and corrugated metal at tree wells.
Ventilation, arch/sidewalk support and electrical-vault strengthening; precise support locations still to be determined.
Structural detail includes new footings and lightweight concrete over metal deck; not evidence of historic sediment or completed repair.

limits: No chronology or catastrophe mechanism inferred from material appearance.
